data.text: Noise measured on ten read-only code tasks (where is --limit parsed, what tokenize matches, which function writes an event, ...), each with and without the hook's real output prepended, Sonnet: hook spoke on 10/10 (240-800 bytes); correct 10/10 both arms; no agent opened a journal record; median tokens 76.0k vs 75.8k (paired delta median +180, range -1.2k..+1.4k); median time 13.7 s vs 13.6 s; tool calls 3 vs 3. Live claude -p in a scratch copy could not run: the local claude CLI's OAuth token has expired (401), which only the owner can renew. init in that copy did install both hooks by default, as intended.
